description: Shell script for testing Git pack-objects with --include-tag option, including setup, packing, unpacking, and verification of tags and objects.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up Git objects, tags, and references for testing.

methods.name: pack without --include-tag
methods.description: Creates a pack file without including tags.

methods.name: unpack objects
methods.description: Unpacks the created pack file into a new clone repository.

methods.name: check unpacked result (have commit, no tag)
methods.description: Verifies that only commit objects are present, and tags are absent.

methods.name: pack with --include-tag
methods.description: Creates a pack file including tags.

methods.name: check unpacked result (have commit, have tag)
methods.description: Verifies that both commit and tag objects are present after unpacking.

methods.name: create hidden inner tag
methods.description: Creates nested tags, including a tag of a tag, and deletes an inner tag.

methods.name: pack explicit outer tag
methods.description: Creates a pack including specific tags and commits.

methods.name: check unpacked result (have all objects)
methods.description: Verifies all objects are present after unpacking.

methods.name: pack implied outer tag
methods.description: Creates a pack including tags implied by references.

methods.name: single-branch clone can transfer tag
methods.description: Tests cloning a repository with a specific branch and transferring tags.
